name: ekka/eth-sepolia
title: Sepolia test network, through Blockscout: read one wallet, send a payment that is already signed
credential_format: This endpoint is public and ignores the token. Any non-empty string works. EKKA cannot connect an API with no credential today.

operations.title: Read the balance of one address

address.description: The address, 0x and 40 hex characters. The kit writes your own into the plan.

operations.title: List the payments one address has sent, newest first
Read the network's current fee levels
Look one payment up by its hash

hash.description: The payment's hash, 0x and 64 hex characters.

operations.title: Send one payment that is already signed. It cannot make, change or sign a payment.

raw_tx.description: The signed payment, 0x02 followed by hex, as bin/tx assembles it.
